fewShots.question: What is our total cloud spend?
fewShots.query: SELECT SUM(effective_cost) AS effective_cost_usd, SUM(billed_cost) AS billed_cost_usd FROM dbo.fact_cost

fewShots.question: Show monthly spend
fewShots.query: SELECT d.month_start, SUM(f.effective_cost) AS effective_cost_usd FROM dbo.fact_cost f JOIN dbo.dim_date d ON f.date_key = d.date_key GROUP BY d.month_start ORDER BY d.month_start

fewShots.question: Top 10 applications by spend
fewShots.query: SELECT TOP 10 a.application_name, SUM(f.effective_cost) AS effective_cost_usd FROM dbo.fact_cost f JOIN dbo.dim_application a ON f.application_code = a.application_code GROUP BY a.application_name ORDER BY effective_cost_usd DESC

fewShots.question: How much spend is unallocated?
fewShots.query: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN allocation_method = 'UNALLOCATED' THEN effective_cost ELSE 0 END) AS unallocated_usd, SUM(CASE WHEN allocation_method = 'UNALLOCATED' THEN effective_cost ELSE 0 END) / SUM(effective_cost) AS unallocated_share FROM dbo.fact_cost

fewShots.question: Which cost centers are over budget in 2026?
fewShots.query: SELECT c.cost_center_name, c.business_unit_name, SUM(b.budget_cost) AS budget_usd, SUM(b.actual_cost) AS actual_usd, SUM(b.actual_cost) - SUM(b.budget_cost) AS variance_usd FROM dbo.fact_budget_vs_actual b JOIN dbo.dim_cost_center c ON b.cost_center_code = c.cost_center_code WHERE YEAR(b.month_start) = 2026 GROUP BY c.cost_center_name, c.business_unit_name HAVING SUM(b.actual_cost) > SUM(b.budget_cost) ORDER BY variance_usd DESC

fewShots.question: Where is our shadow IT and zombie spend?
fewShots.query:
SELECT scope_key, provider,
       SUM(CASE WHEN is_shadow_it = 1 THEN effective_cost ELSE 0 END) AS shadow_it_usd,
       SUM(CASE WHEN is_zombie_spend = 1 THEN effective_cost ELSE 0 END) AS zombie_usd
FROM dbo.fact_cost
GROUP BY scope_key, provider
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN is_shadow_it = 1 OR is_zombie_spend = 1 THEN effective_cost ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN is_shadow_it = 1 OR is_zombie_spend = 1 THEN effective_cost ELSE 0 END) DESC

fewShots.question: Which products are under-licensed?
fewShots.query: SELECT p.product_name, l.byol_cores_installed, l.cores_entitled_active, l.core_shortfall FROM dbo.fact_license_position l JOIN dbo.dim_product p ON l.product_id = p.product_id WHERE l.core_shortfall > 0 ORDER BY l.core_shortfall DESC

fewShots.question: Which production VMs have no recent backup?
fewShots.query: SELECT vm_name, resource_group, application_code, last_success FROM dbo.fact_vm_backup_coverage WHERE is_unprotected_prod = 1 ORDER BY vm_name

fewShots.question: How much do we pay for backups of deleted VMs?
fewShots.query: SELECT month_start, SUM(storage_cost_usd) AS orphaned_backup_usd FROM dbo.fact_backup_cost WHERE is_orphaned = 1 GROUP BY month_start ORDER BY month_start
